newsitem.title: USA: Four Corners Ariz. 750 MW unit 5 restarted Sunday.
newsitem.headline: Four Corners Ariz. 750 MW unit 5 restarted Sunday.

text.p: The 750 megawatt (MW) unit 5 at the Four Corners coal-fired power plant in Arizona was restarted on Sunday after being shut nearly two weeks ago for unplanned repairs, sources familiar with the unit's operations said Monday.
Unit 5 was said to be at full load Monday as was Four Corners' 750 MW unit 4.
The plant's units 1, 2 and 3 were at normal rates of 185 MW, 185 MW, and 245 MW, respectively, the sources said.
Arizona Public Service Co operates Four Corners and owns units 1, 2 and 3 along with 15 percent of units 4 and 5.
Southern California Edison Co holds a 48 percent stake in units 4 and 5.
